definitions.meaning: a large jib sail on a yacht
the Ligurian harbour city of north-west Italy

explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a big foresail used by racing yachts and the major seaport on Italy's Ligurian coast.

parts.note: read as a request for the word opposite in sense to 'very much', i.e. a small amount

explanation.definitionFit: The antonym of 'much' or 'a lot' is a small quantity, which is what this word means.

parts.note: bran is the husk of cereal grain, eaten as a breakfast cereal
a dish is a shallow bowl

explanation.surface: Someone waves a breakfast bowl of cereal about with a flourish.
explanation.definitionFit: To flourish a weapon or object is to wave it about showily.

indicators.note: turns tells us the letters of the two words are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: A man's partner changes, drifting into scepticism.
explanation.definitionFit: Atheism is a lack of belief in any god.

clue.text: Side to side movement in soccer, perhaps

definitions.text: Side to side movement in soccer, perhaps

parts.words: Side to side movement in soccer, perhaps
parts.note: reads like a pass across the pitch, but means a player moving from one team (side) to another

explanation.definitionFit: When a footballer is sold to another club, the deal is the formal move between teams.

clue.text: Missed tea, perhaps, will take coffee

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the clue words are one possible arrangement of the letters, so rearrange them

explanation.surface: Someone who missed afternoon tea settles for a coffee instead.
explanation.definitionFit: A demitasse is a small cup of strong black coffee, served after dinner.

clue.text: In the study I have a fireplace to blacken

parts.note: a den is a private study or retreat
a grate is the metal frame of a fireplace, and by extension the fireplace

explanation.surface: Someone in their study by the hearth seems ready to smear a rival's name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blacken' here means to blacken someone's character, not soot from the fire.
explanation.definitionFit: To blacken a reputation is to defame or speak ill of someone.

definitions.meaning: a colour, like that of grass
new to a job, untrained, like a raw recruit

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a colour of the spectrum and slang for being naive or untrained.

parts.note: sounds like a ceiling lamp but means the ring of light painted above a saint's head

explanation.definitionFit: A saint's glowing circle sits literally above the head, a light overhead.

clue.text: Don't give up getting the unit back in shape

indicators.note: in means the reversed word goes inside the other piece

parts.note: a cone is a geometric shape

indicators.note: back tells us the word unit is read backwards

explanation.surface: Encouragement to keep going while getting the team back into shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting the unit back in shape' reads as a coach's pep talk; 'back' is the reversal signal and 'in' the container, with 'shape' the outer piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To carry on is the opposite of giving up.

clue.text: A loose nickname for the BBC

parts.note: to loose a knot is to untie it

explanation.surface: Someone casually refers to the broadcaster by its familiar pet name.
explanation.walkthrough: The BBC (British Broadcasting Corporation) has long been called 'Auntie' in Britain, for its prim, motherly image.
explanation.definitionFit: British viewers fondly call the national broadcaster by this family term for a mother's sister.

indicators.note: used in shows the letters sit within the word experiment

explanation.surface: Some ghost or spirit has been used as part of a scientific trial.
explanation.definitionFit: A peri is a fairy or good spirit in Persian mythology.

parts.note: read as performers' nerves, but the phrase means to display terror visibly, as if on a stage

explanation.definitionFit: Stage fright is nerves on display, so the phrase describes letting one's terror be visible.

parts.note: counterfeit means fake
a hood is a head covering

explanation.surface: A forger needs a fake cover story to hide behind.
explanation.definitionFit: A falsehood is an untruth.

parts.note: sounds like a greeting, but a fox hunt's gathering is called a meet and this is the hunters' cry

explanation.walkthrough: In British fox hunting, the gathering of riders and hounds is the 'meet'.
explanation.definitionFit: Huntsmen shout this when the fox is sighted during a hunt.

clue.text: Having had a rise, a man goes on holiday

indicators.note: goes on means the man's name is placed after the other piece

parts.note: leave is time off work, a holiday
Ned is a man's name, short for Edward

explanation.surface: After a pay rise, a man heads off on holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rise' sounds like a pay rise; it is dough rising with yeast.
explanation.definitionFit: Leavened bread has been made to rise by yeast or another raising agent.

clue.text: She plays about in various casts

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other
various suggests the letters of casts take a different order

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A performer appears in a range of different casts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She plays' is the definition, a performer; 'various' is the anagram signal on the casts, and the short word for 'about' sits inside the rearranged letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A female performer takes roles in plays.

parts.note: to reach a decision at the end of a reasoning process

explanation.definitionFit: To come to a conclusion is to settle a matter at the end of deliberation, ending and judging at once.

definitions.meaning: to waste money or time bit by bit
a piece of fruit or meat fried in batter

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means waste gradually; as a noun it is a battered fried morsel such as a banana or corn one.

clue.text: It makes pears lie against the wall, for example

definitions.text: It makes pears lie against the wall, for example

indicators.note: makes tells us the letters of the next words are made into something new

explanation.surface: A gardening device that trains fruit trees flat against a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: An espalier is a trellis on which fruit trees are trained flat against a wall.

clue.text: Make a note of the time perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints the word time is one possible arrangement of these letters

explanation.surface: Someone is told to jot down the hour.
explanation.definitionFit: An entry or memo in a list is a separate thing noted down.

definitions.meaning: of a spirit, drunk without water or mixer

explanation.definitionFit: Whisky served straight is undiluted, and the old term for cattle or oxen is the same word.

clue.text: Sets out an increase in salary, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the words are spoken aloud to give a different spelling

parts.note: a raise is an increase in pay

explanation.surface: A boss lays out the terms of a pay increase.
explanation.definitionFit: To array things is to arrange or lay them out in order.

clue.text: It's hard hit when ironworkers strike

definitions.text: It's hard hit when ironworkers strike

parts.words: It's hard hit when ironworkers strike
parts.note: sounds like an industrial dispute, but the smiths strike metal on this block

explanation.definitionFit: A blacksmith hammers hot iron on this heavy steel block.

parts.note: sounds like a warning, but means the word photographers ask people to say to smile

explanation.definitionFit: Saying this dairy word forces the mouth into a grin for photographs.

indicators.note: to become shows the letters change into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone has learned to relax and take things easy.
explanation.definitionFit: A tolerant person is relaxed and accepting.

definitions.meaning: journalists ... a story by reporting on it

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means hide, and in journalism it also means to report on an event.

clue.text: Lady dines out, showing gluttony perhaps?
